models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (RX 9060 XT KV-streaming llama.cpp fork)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B IQ4_XS on a 16GB RX 9060 XT with KV-cache streaming to system RAM
models.why: reported run of Qwen3.8-27B IQ4_XS on a 16GB Radeon RX 9060 XT: a custom llama.cpp fork streams the KV cache between VRAM and 24GB system RAM; 42.7 t/s at ~20K context and 35 t/s at ~200K, targeting 262K, with MTP speculative decoding and Q4 KV values / Q8 keys

engines.hardware: Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB + 24GB DDR5 system RAM
engines.quant: IQ4_XS; Q4 KV values / Q8 keys; MTP speculative decoding + n-gram prediction; ~18-20K context (35 t/s at ~200K context, 262K target)
